title: Technical Explainer Series
description: Brand and creative direction for an educational video series.

caseStudy.blurb: A three-part public education series explaining how Agility approaches Digit's AI stack, functional safety, and data security.
caseStudy.teamHtml: Brand Designer (me), Study Hall Studio
objectives: Make complex technical topics clear to a general audience.
Position Agility as a thought leader on safe, trustworthy humanoid robots.
Keep all three episodes in one consistent visual language.
caseStudy.contribution: Working with Study Hall Studio, I led creative direction and brand consistency for the series' graphics: animations, lower thirds, transitions, on-screen graphics, and data visualization. I made sure every episode carried Agility's visual identity.
results: Three episodes published as a cohesive series on Agility's channels.
A shared graphics system for animation, type, and data visualization across every episode.
